_comment: Pinned program for the multi-clip OUT-OF-BOUNDS / honest-ungrounded query 'Does #99 score the first goal?' on the best-goal clip. Same chain as the filter-seven grounding program but filters on text == '99', a jersey NOT in the cache. The filter matches nobody -> temporal_order produces an empty subject (subject_label is None) -> the answer step GROUNDS OUT honestly (grounded=false, reason 'no-grounded-answer') rather than fabricating a confident 'No' about a player we never located (the honesty discriminator, primitives.py _answer_temporal). Validates against ../schema/dsl.schema.json.
